criteria.requirement: Add actual MarkdownConverter.convert_with_options(html, **overrides), leaving convert(html) and subclass convert_* signatures intact. Reuse subclass behavior without rerunning a potentially required-argument constructor; isolate nested dict/list/tuple/set configuration containers from both base and caller overrides while preserving opaque callbacks by identity. Normalize bs4_options as the constructor does, enforce strip/convert exclusion, and build fresh conversion-function cache bound to this isolated converter. Previously cached base methods, sequential calls, simultaneous calls and callback/errors must not mutate base options/cache or caller option containers. Demonstrate actual differing converted documents, not just returned option dictionaries.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
